Almost everyone gets a sore back occasionally, but how do you know if it is just a pulled muscle or something serious? Your spine protects your spinal cord and nerves. When a disc slips or a joint becomes inflamed, the warning signs usually extend well beyond a basic backache.

If any pain is affecting you in your daily activities, consulting a spine specialist in Ahmedabad will help detect the underlying cause before nerve damage occurs.

Common Warning Signs

The symptoms of spine problems vary according to the nerve or disc involved:

  • Shooting Leg Pain: Sharp pain radiating down your buttocks, thighs, or calves, often called sciatica, usually means a bulging disc is pressing against a nerve root.
  • Tingling and Numbness: Constant pins and needles sensations in your fingers, hands, or feet point directly to spinal nerve irritation.
  • Sudden Muscle Weakness: Dropping objects frequently, struggling to lift your toes while walking, or feeling your knees give way suggests significant nerve compression.
  • Persistent Morning Stiffness: Pain and stiffness in your lower back or neck that takes hours to ease up can indicate spinal arthritis.
